scope: Depth priorities inside the 14-theme societal, cultural, consumer, political, institutional, firm, infrastructure, and geopolitical atlas
interpretation: This register chooses high-value next tests; it is not a claim that one dataset should answer the whole program.

execution_rule.broad_atlas_first: PSID authenticated family/person extract for the material/time/care bridge
execution_rule.health_cost_alternative: UAS Older Ages or Monthly Panel only for the narrower dated health-cost episode
execution_rule.public_record_stage_first: Worker remedy receipt and later stability when an identifier-bearing follow-up is available
execution_rule.boundary: Do not pool PSID, UAS, MEPS, SIPP, or administrative routes as if they were one same-unit episode.

priorities.name: Household pressure and care
required_stages: dated bill health or care event
priorities.current_evidence: SIPP same-person monthly screens and MEPS dated health-event scaffolds
priorities.open_blocker: event-specific alternatives, obligation, institutional response, and later recovery are not linked in one retained unit
priorities.next_route: authorized MEPS restoration or UAS/PSID respondent file

priorities.name: Consumer remedy and practical exit
priorities.unit: same customer, account, or case episode
priorities.current_evidence: CFPB, FTC, recall, fraud, and 27-case platform-remedy ledgers
priorities.open_blocker: alternatives, verified receipt, durability, and protected or sacrificed outcome are sparse
priorities.next_route: small account-level or remedy-contact follow-up ledger

priorities.name: Work and control
priorities.current_evidence: AI/work surveys, adjudicated platform cases, worker-voice and wage-remedy ledgers
priorities.open_blocker: worker-side receipt, durable control, household outcome, and free alternative work remain uncommon

priorities.name: Care and public-system usability
priorities.unit: same person, appointment, or benefit episode
priorities.current_evidence: MEPS, SIPP, SHED, HRSA named-site, SNAP, Medicaid, and disability-access layers
priorities.open_blocker: appointment completion, adequacy, notice/route effort, and continuity are not consistently observed
priorities.next_route: privacy-approved appointment or benefit episode ledger

priorities.name: Infrastructure and state consequence
priorities.unit: identifiable project, contract, capability, place, or state episode
priorities.current_evidence: data-center, grid, defense, critical-materials, alliance-response, and state-capacity ledgers
priorities.open_blocker: realized user benefit, replacement, affected-actor response, and leverage are usually separate from the capability record
